hints.buttons: Use Button for every action. Destructive only for actions that cannot be undone.
hints.fields: Label + Input or Textarea. A field's validation error stays below it, in red.
hints.selects: In forms use NativeSelect (it submits with the form and works on phones). Select is for rich lists outside forms.
hints.choices: Checkbox for yes/no inside a form, Switch to turn something on or off at once, RadioGroup for one choice among a few options.
hints.tabs: To split a screen into parts of the same subject.
hints.badges: For status and category, never as a button.
hints.cards: To group a block of content with a title.
hints.alerts: Only for page states (expired link, access denied). Action results go to the notice banner (ADR 0016).
